description: This file contains a C# interface definition for a grain in the Orleans framework, specifically for a stateless worker stream producer grain with a method to produce messages to a stream.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerStreamProducerGrain
classes.description: Interface for a stateless worker stream producer grain with a method to produce messages to a stream.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Asynchronously produces a message to a specified stream using provided stream ID, provider, and message content.
